## Task Description

Read your task brief first: /Users/saif/Experiments/doraval/.superpowers/sdd/issue-44-remaining/task-1-brief.md
It contains the full task text from the plan. It is your requirements, with the exact values to use verbatim.

This is Doraval (`dora`), a context-effectiveness CLI. `dora skill unused` already exists (commit 8c6f6ca, ticket #45). `dora agent-help` is built from `src/cli/capabilities.ts` via `buildCapabilities()`. Work from: /Users/saif/Experiments/doraval

## Before You Begin

If you have questions, ask them now. Otherwise implement.

## Your Job

7. Run focused tests while iterating; run `bun test src/cli/capabilities.test.ts test/cli.test.ts` before commit.
8. Commit only Task 1 files (capabilities + tests). Do not commit README, website, or skill docs (Task 2). Do not commit CONTEXT.md.
9. Self-review your diff. Do not spawn subagents.

Commit style (this repo): Conventional Commits, Capital after colon, imperative, body explains why. Example:
feat: Label skill unused read-only on agent-help

A Runner that treats the whole skill group as writes will not run the check.

#46
